info.title: trcaret
info.description:
Reads a tree from stdin and prints the source text. If 'line-number' is
specified, the line number range for the tree is printed.
This program is part of the Trash toolkit.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Reads a tree from stdin and prints lines and caret marks.

options.name: --file
options.description: Read parse tree data from file instead of stdin.

options.name: --with-filename
options.description: Print the file name for each match.
